title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go + v1.156.0 parity bump
author: Ava Thompson
description:
Motivation: SDK surface area across Python/TypeScript/Go diverged in subtle ways for auth configuration, retry/backoff defaults, and streaming ergonomics. This PR unifies those behaviors so product teams get consistent semantics across languages and prepares the SDKs for a v1.156.0 parity release.

What changed (high level):
- Consolidated auth token sources and retry-on-auth-failure behavior: all SDKs now support explicit token providers, environment fallback, and automatic short-lived token refresh with the same retry hooks.
- Standardized retry/backoff config and defaults (exponential backoff with jitter, max_retries=5 by default). Introduced an explicit RetryConfig type in each language to make configuration ergonomic.
- Streaming parity: added consistent streaming helpers (sync/async where applicable), reconnect/backpressure hooks, and improved close semantics to avoid dangling goroutines/callback leaks in Go and Python. TypeScript streaming now exposes an AbortController-friendly API and improved typings.
- Version bumps: package manifests updated to v1.156.0 across sdks/python, sdks/typescript, sdks/go.
- Tests: added cross-SDK conformance tests for auth+retry scenarios and improved integration coverage for streaming reconnects.
- Docs: updated quickstart and migration notes for breaking defaults (none enabled) and added examples for new RetryConfig.

Commits summary:
- refactor(sdk): extract common auth/provider interface across languages
- feat(sdk): add RetryConfig + unify retry logic (python/ts/go)
- fix(streaming): close semantics and reconnect guard for go streaming server stub
- feat(ts): AbortController-friendly streaming + improved types
- docs: migration guide and examples for RetryConfig
- chore: version bump to v1.156.0, changelog updates

Files changed (high-level):
- sdks/python/redwood/auth.py (refactor + provider interface)
- sdks/python/redwood/retries.py (new RetryConfig + tests)
- sdks/python/redwood/streaming.py (stream helpers + close fixes)
- sdks/typescript/src/auth/index.ts (unified token provider)
- sdks/typescript/src/retries.ts (RetryConfig + backoff)
- sdks/typescript/src/streaming.ts (AbortController integration)
- sdks/go/auth/provider.go (provider interface)
- sdks/go/retry/retry.go (backoff implementation)
- sdks/go/streaming/stream.go (close/reconnect fixes)
- docs/quickstarts/sdks.md (examples)
